briefdescription.para: Reorders the current graph to the most profitable order starting from leaves to the root.

detaileddescription.para: It allows to rotate small subgraphs and reduce the number of reshuffles if the leaf nodes use the same order. In this case we can merge the orders and just shuffle user node instead of shuffling its operands. Plus, even the leaf nodes have different orders, it allows to sink reordering in the graph closer to the root node and merge it later during analysis.
